description: The Global Oil and Gas Features Database, known as GOGI, is an open geodatabase of oil and gas infrastructure worldwide produced by the National Energy Technology Laboratory. The EDX pages read on 2026-09-26 give the database (DOI 10.18141/1427300, dated 12 December 2017) as a zip of an ArcGIS geodatabase under Creative Commons Attribution and the Open Data Commons Attribution License, a separate technical report (DOI 10.18141/1427573) describing how the inventory was developed, and a web map on EDX Spatial. The work was performed under an agreement between NETL and the Environmental Defense Fund for the Climate and Clean Air Coalition oil and gas methane science studies, funded by EDF, OGCI member companies and the coalition. Coverage is global; the feature classes and sources are set out in the technical report, which was not opened. Downloads are free. Caveats: the database dates from 2017 and has not been updated on the pages read, completeness varies by country, and the geodatabase format needs GIS software. Simulation uses are hazard exposure of oil and gas assets, network flow and supply chain models of fuel infrastructure, and attribution of methane emissions to sources. Related records: data-ogim-oil-gas-infrastructure-mapping is a newer global inventory that builds on such sources, and data-netl-energy-data-exchange-edx is the NETL platform hosting it.
